name: Parts inventory
about: Your parts list (like InvenTree / PartsBox, kept simple): screws, nuts, bearings, springs, electronics, filament, tools — how many and where. Say "add 50 M3x10 screws, drawer A1", "I used 4 608 bearings", "do I have 10k resistors?" or "check: 4 M3 screws, 2 608 bearings". Stored only on this PC (data/inventory.json).
description: The user's own parts inventory: list or find parts, add / use (take out) / set / remove items with quantity and location, or check whether a parts list is in stock. Use it when the user asks what parts they have, says they bought or used parts, or before suggesting parts to buy.
instructions: Turn the request into an inventory action. list = show everything (or a category in query); find = look for parts (query = what); add = the user got / has parts (items with name, qty, location, category: screws, nuts, bearings, electronics, filament, tools…); use = parts taken out or used up (items with name, qty); set = the real count now; remove = delete from the list; check = are these parts in stock (items with name, qty). Names short and plain: "M3x10 screw", "608 bearing", "10k resistor 0805", "PLA black 1 kg". Example: {"action": "add", "items": [{"name": "M3x10 screw", "qty": 50, "location": "drawer A1", "category": "screws"}]}. Answer with the JSON only.
